title: SOA - Try it out : agent activation after closing the page
summary: The Sales Order Agent now activates only after a task is submitted rather than when the Create Task page closes, preventing unintended activation when the form is cancelled.
key_points: Agent activation deferred to task submission
Cancelling the Create Task form no longer triggers agent activation
Changes affect the task creation workflow in the SOA setup and implementation
Improves user control over agent behavior during task creation
quote: Defer SOA agent activation in "Try it out" until the task is submitted
